model.gitlab_snowflake.mart_arr.name: mart_arr
model.gitlab_snowflake.mart_arr.description:
Data mart to explore ARR. This model is built using the same logic as the Zuora UI out of the box MRR Trend Report. The report looks at the charges associated with subscriptions, along with their effective dates and subscription statuses, and calculates ARR.

The below query will pull ARR by month. You can add additional dimensions to the query to build out your analysis.

SELECT
  arr_month,
  SUM(arr)  AS arr
FROM FROM PROD.restricted_safe_common_mart_sales.mart_arr
WHERE arr_month < DATE_TRUNC('month',CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1 DESC

Charges_month_by_month CTE:

This CTE amortizes

model.gitlab_snowflake.mart_product_usag.description:
This table unions the sets of all Self-Managed and SaaS **paid users**. The data from this table will be used for Customer Product Insights.

The grain of this table is subscription per namespace || uuid-hostname per month.

The join to `dim_subscription_snapshot_bottom_up` uses a datediff of -1 day so that the `subscription_status` reflects the position at the end of the previous month. This avoids the situation where a subscription expires on the last day of the month and new one begins on the 1st of the next month meaning the join produces a NULL.

model.gitlab_snowflake.rpt_namespace_onb.description:
**Description:**

This model is aggregated at the ultimate parent namespaces level and contains a wide variety of namesapace onboarding behaviors and attributes. This model contains one row per ultimate_parent_namespace_id and is designed to meet most of the primary analytics use cases for the Growth team. 

**Data Grain:**
* ultimate_parent_namespace_id
* namespace_created_at

**Intended Usage**

This model is intended to be used as a reporting model for the Growth Section and any other teams at GitLab that are interested in ultimate parent namespace level onboarding behaviors and attributes.

namespace_created_month.description: The month of the ultimate parent namespace creation.

namespace_created_week.description: The week of the ultimate parent namespace creation.

namespace_type.description: The type of Ultimate Parent Namespace (user,group,project)

days_since_namespace_creation.name: days_since_namespace_creation
days_since_namespace_creation.description: Days since namespace creation when model was last refreshed. This can be used to filter by ultimate parent namespace maturity.

is_namespace_created_within_2min_of_crea.name: is_namespace_created_within_2min_of_creator_invite_acceptance

This data source combines product usage metrics across GitLab.com (SaaS) and self-managed GitLab deployments. model.gitlab_snowflake.map_free_instance.name: map_free_instances_to_crm_account_prep
model.gitlab_snowflake.map_free_instance.description:
Maps Free Self-Managed instances to CRM accounts. It does so in a 3 stage process:
  1. Tries to join the host_name of the instance to the account domain registered in SFDC.
  2. If above does not work, tries to extract the company name from the host_name and join it to the company name in SFDC
  3. If above does not work, joins the host_name to the email address domain of leads associated to accounts.
This model runs every Tuesday. If the run is skipped, will try to run on the next day.

Calculates comprehensive maturity scores across Core Development, DevOps, Collaboration, and Security dimensions, then maps instances to CRM accounts using the latest PtPF scores. model.gitlab_snowflake.model_mart_crm_ac.name: model_mart_crm_account_id
model.gitlab_snowflake.model_mart_crm_ac.description: Summarises per account and score date the scores given by the PtE and PtC models. It also solves discrepancies when the score of PtC = 1 and the score of PtE = 5 for the same score date, meaning that the account is highly likely to expand and contract at the same time. This is done by lowering or upping the score with the lowest distance to the score mean relative to its standard deviation. If the score with the lowest variance is the PtC, then the score will go from 1 to 2. If the score with the lowest variance is the PtE, then the score will go from 5 to 4.

This model is a derived fact table that is built using the `fct_trial` model. It identifies the first trial record for each namespace by deduplicating based on the `valid_from` column.

The grain of this model is `trial order per namespace`.

## Process

For each namespace, this model:
- Groups records by namespace_id
- Orders them by valid_from (earliest first) and internal_order_id
- Selects only the first record using:
  `QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY latest_namespace_id ORDER BY valid_from, internal_order_id) = 1`

Provides comprehensive tracking of ticket assignment patterns, workload distribution, and engineer

- **EVENING_EMEA**: 20:00 UTC
